channelScope.SHAME: Silent outside chat in the saved readings until TP64 part 3 measures a varying output.

authorReliability.source: TP45 Table 1, deep blog cohort, correlations across authors between date halves.
authorReliability.lookup: Use the measured posts per side, split, and raw or partly cleared arm. A count alone does not establish eligibility. Unsupported counts have no measured entry.
authorReliability.interval: 95% whole-author bootstrap; cohort reliability, not a confidence interval on one person.

textState.reference: TP50 chat situations; each block takes its maximum across varying standardized outputs. High means strictly above the reference median maximum.
textState.basis: Filed rates by assigned word. Application to a new text needs the frozen reference calibration.
